description: This file defines and exports functions to create different types of select list components for a Text User Interface (TUI), specifically: general select lists, searchable select lists, filterable select lists, and a settings list. It imports external components, themes, and types, and provides factory functions to instantiate these UI components with specific themes and parameters.

methods.name: export function createSelectList(items: SelectItem[], maxVisible = 7) { createSelectList
methods.description: Creates a standard select list component with the provided items and maximum visible items, applying the default theme.

methods.name: export function createSearchableSelectList(items: SelectItem[], maxVisible = 7) { createSearchableSelectList
methods.description: Creates a searchable select list component with the provided items and maximum visible items, applying the searchable theme.

methods.name: export function createFilterableSelectList(items: FilterableSelectItem[], maxVisible = 7) { createFilterableSelectList
methods.description: Creates a filterable select list component with the provided items and maximum visible items, applying the filterable theme.

methods.name: export function createSettingsList( createSettingsList
methods.description: Creates a settings list component with the provided items, change and cancel callbacks, maximum visible items, applying the settings theme.
